headline: Figure, a US humanoid-robot maker, melted its retired Figure 02 robots in a Finnish steel furnace, a farewell that actor Arnold Schwarzenegger suggested.
score_reason: Pool score 4 kept as the late gap-fill instruction says: a widely shared robot stunt with no wider effect; Figure posted the film on 30 Sep 2026, before the window, so the usual stale rule would lower it by 1.
importance_line: Mostly a spectacle for people who follow humanoid robots, it shows how a robot maker disposes of old machines full of its own technology, but the claims that the jumps were autonomous and the footage real come from Figure alone.
summary: Deseret News reports, citing Figure's own film and blog post of 30 Sep 2026, that the US humanoid-robot maker melted down its retired Figure 02 robots at a foundry in Imatra, Finland, in a Terminator-style send-off with a cameo by Arnold Schwarzenegger, who played a robot from the future in those films. The melting was Schwarzenegger's suggestion: on 19 Aug 2026 he replied "You should melt them" to a post on X in which Figure's chief executive, Brett Adcock, asked for ideas for the send-off, and Figure says it chose melting to protect its custom hardware and trained the robots to make the jump on their own.
